title: Keep the account entrance clear of Workshop modal controls
acceptance: The account entrance is visible in the Workshop scene stack.
The account entrance is hidden and cannot receive focus while scene editors, scene sheets, visual selection or source selection are open.
The account entrance returns after editing or source selection closes.
The complete Workshop touch flow passes on iPhone 12 and small Android portrait without forced taps.
Existing reader modal behavior and required release checks remain intact.

evidence.note: Both phone scene-writing flows timed out because the global Sign in control intercepted the Done tap on both attempts.

Permanent account-visibility assertion fails before the stylesheet repair. The first repaired run passed Android and both studio flows but exposed an existing iPhone search debounce race; waiting for the one filtered book, as neighboring specs do, resolved it. Final phone flows: 12/12 without retries, then 4/4 on provider merge 785c6f54. Required checks passed: hygiene, audit (no high/critical), compatibility, diagram, 1895 unit tests with 2 existing skips, build, first-load 61.2 KB/64 KB, and browser gate 50 passed with 3 existing skips. GitHub CI and deployment pending.
